data.name: AnyHeaderPolicyConflict
data.value: AllowAnyHeader() cannot be combined with WithHeaders: a policy that allows every header has no header to list.

data.name: AnyMethodPolicyConflict
data.value: AllowAnyMethod() cannot be combined with WithMethods: a policy that allows every method has no method to list.

data.name: AnyOriginCredentialsConflict
data.value: AllowAnyOrigin() cannot be combined with AllowCredentials(). The Fetch standard forbids 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' on a response to a credentialed request, and echoing every origin instead would let any site read responses with the user's credentials. List the trusted origins with WithOrigins, or decide per origin with SetIsOriginAllowed.

data.name: AnyOriginPolicyConflict
data.value: AllowAnyOrigin() cannot be combined with WithOrigins or SetIsOriginAllowed: a policy that allows every origin has no origin to restrict.

data.name: CorsOriginRequired
data.value: A CORS policy must allow at least one origin. Call WithOrigins, SetIsOriginAllowed or AllowAnyOrigin().

data.name: CorsPolicyAlreadyRegistered
data.value: A CORS policy named '{0}' is already registered.

data.name: CorsPolicyNotRegistered
data.value: No CORS policy named '{0}' has been registered. Register it with options.AddPolicy(name, configure) in UseCors.

data.name: CorsResponseStartingFeatureRequired
data.value: UseCors requires IWebResponseStartingFeature for actual responses. Use the default Web.Hosting server or implement the response-starting feature in the custom server.

data.name: CorsTokenInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a {1}: it must be an RFC 9110 token.

data.name: CorsTokenRequired
data.value: A {0} must not be null or empty.

data.name: CorsWildcardNotSupported
data.value: '*' is not a {0}. List the names explicitly.

data.name: CorsWildcardOptionRequired
data.value: '*' is not a {0}. Call {1}() to allow every one.

data.name: DefaultCorsPolicyAlreadyRegistered
data.value: A default CORS policy is already registered.

data.name: OpaqueOriginPredicateRequired
data.value: The 'null' origin cannot be allowed by value: sandboxed documents, local files and cross-origin redirects all send it, so allowing it would allow all of them. Call SetIsOriginAllowed to accept it deliberately.

data.name: OriginCharacterInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: it contains whitespace, a control character or a non-ASCII character. Write an internationalized host in its ASCII (punycode) form, which is what the browser sends.

data.name: OriginHostInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: '{1}' is not a host name.

data.name: OriginHostRequired
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: it has no host.

data.name: OriginIpv6AddressInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: its host is not an IPv6 address.

data.name: OriginIpv6PortSeparatorRequired
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: expected ':port' after the IPv6 address.

data.name: OriginRequired
data.value: An origin must not be empty.

data.name: OriginPathQueryOrFragmentNotAllowed
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: an origin has no path, query or fragment. Remove '{1}'.

data.name: OriginPortInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: '{1}' is not a port number.

data.name: OriginSchemeInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: '{1}' is not a URL scheme.

data.name: OriginSyntaxInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: expected scheme://host[:port], for example https://app.example.

data.name: OriginTrailingSlashNotAllowed
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: an origin has no path. Remove the trailing '/'.

data.name: OriginUserInformationNotAllowed
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: an origin has no user information.

data.name: OriginWildcardNotSupported
data.value: '{0}' is not an origin: wildcards are not supported. Call SetIsOriginAllowed to match a pattern, or AllowAnyOrigin() to allow every origin.

data.name: OriginWildcardOptionRequired
data.value: '*' is not an origin. Call AllowAnyOrigin() to allow every origin.
